# Akureyri Lodge

> Akureyri Lodge is a historic timber house dating back to 1896, offering three individual apartments in a quiet part of Akureyri, North Iceland. Each apartment has a private entrance, kitchen, bathroom and living space. Guests share an outdoor area and hot tub, while private parking and free Wi-Fi are available on site. The city centre is just over 1 km away and easily accessible on foot. Guests can book one apartment individually or combine two or all three apartments for larger groups travelling together.

## The house
- Address: Lækjargata 3, 600 Akureyri, North Iceland, in the old town (Innbærinn). Map: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=L%C3%A6kjargata%203%2C%20600%20Akureyri
- Three self-contained apartments in a timber house from 1896, each with its own entrance, kitchen, bathroom and living space. Owners: Stella & Eyþór.
- Shared by all guests: the outdoor area and terrace, a hot tub (07:00 to 23:00) with an outdoor shower, free private parking, free Wi-Fi. Open all year.
- Check-in from 16:00, check-out by 11:00. Minimum stay 2 nights. Pets are not allowed.

## The Grand Residence
- Size: 116 m². Guests: Up to 8, and 2 more on request for a fee. Bedrooms: Four upstairs, and an extra bedroom downstairs on request. Bathrooms: Two. Television: With Netflix, in the living room downstairs.
- The four upstairs bedrooms have twin beds which are normally prepared as double beds. The beds can be separated into twin beds on request.
- The extra bedroom downstairs, available on request, also has 2 single beds, made up to suit your needs.
- Page: https://akureyrilodge.is/apartments/grand-residence/

## The Classic Apartment
- Size: 52 m². Guests: Up to 4. Bedrooms: Two. Bathroom: One, with a walk-in shower. Television: With Netflix, in the living room.
- The two bedrooms each have twin beds which are normally prepared as double beds. They can be separated into twin beds on request.
- Page: https://akureyrilodge.is/apartments/classic-apartment/

## The Cosy Studio
- Size: 40 m². Guests: Up to 2, and 2 more on the sofa bed. Beds: Two 90 cm beds and a sofa bed. Bathroom: One, with a roll-in shower. Access: Wheelchair accessible.
- The studio has two 90 cm beds, normally prepared together as a double, plus a sofa bed in the living area.
- Page: https://akureyrilodge.is/apartments/cosy-studio/

## Booking
- Book directly on the website (Book your stay), which opens the Godo booking engine with the chosen apartment, dates and guests: https://akureyrilodge.is/
- Standard rate: free cancellation up to 14 days before arrival; after that the full amount is charged. A non-refundable rate is also offered. The terms for your dates are shown before you book.
- Contact: +354 883 2313, akureyrilodge@akureyrilodge.is

## Around the house on foot
- Nonnahús (A writer’s childhood home, 650 m): 9 min walk
- Botanical garden (Lystigarðurinn, 650 m): 9 min walk
- Akureyri Museum (Minjasafnið, 700 m): 10 min walk
- Church steps (Akureyrarkirkja, 1 km): 14 min walk
- Swimming pool (Sundlaug Akureyrar, 1.1 km): 16 min walk
- Listagil (The art street and museum, 1.1 km): 16 min walk
- Town square (Ráðhústorg, 1.3 km): 18 min walk
- Hof (Culture house, 1.5 km): 21 min walk

## Questions and answers
### How many apartments does Akureyri Lodge have?
Akureyri Lodge has three individual apartments: The Grand Residence, The Classic Apartment and The Cosy Studio. Each apartment has its own private entrance, kitchen, bathroom and living space.

### Can I book more than one apartment?
Yes. You can book one apartment individually, or book two or all three apartments together if you are travelling as a larger family or group. This allows you to stay together in the same historic house while still having your own individual apartment.

### How many guests can stay at Akureyri Lodge?
The Grand Residence accommodates up to 8 guests as standard, with two additional sleeping places available in a separate bedroom on request for an extra fee. The Classic Apartment accommodates up to 4 guests. The Cosy Studio is suitable for 2 guests, with a sofa bed available for additional sleeping capacity for 2 persons.

### Can the beds be separated into twin beds?
Yes. The twin beds in the apartments are normally prepared together as double beds using a large double sheet. If you prefer separate twin beds, please let us know in advance.

### Is the hot tub shared?
Yes. The hot tub is shared by guests staying at Akureyri Lodge. It can be used between 07:00 and 23:00. The switch is located directly outside the hot tub, and an outdoor shower is available beside it.

### How long does the hot tub take to heat?
If the hot tub is being filled from empty, allow approximately 60 minutes for it to heat up.

### Is there a BBQ?
Yes, but the BBQ is available exclusively to guests staying in The Grand Residence.

### Is Akureyri Lodge wheelchair accessible?
The Cosy Studio is wheelchair accessible and has a roll-in shower. The historic nature of the house means that accessibility differs between the individual apartments. Please contact us if you have specific accessibility requirements before booking.

### Is parking available?
Yes. Private parking is available directly in front of Akureyri Lodge.

### Is Wi-Fi available?
Yes. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property.

### Are pets allowed?
No. Unfortunately, pets are not allowed at Akureyri Lodge.

### Is a baby cot available?
A baby cot and high chair are available on request. Please let us know before arrival if you need either one.

### What time is check-in?
Check-in is from 16:00.

### What time is check-out?
Check-out is by 11:00. When you leave, please send us a short message so we know that you have departed.

### Is there a minimum stay?
Yes. The minimum stay is 2 nights.

### How do I book?
You can book directly through our website using the Book your stay button. Our booking system shows current availability and allows you to complete your booking and payment online. If you have any questions or would prefer to speak to us directly, you can also contact us by phone or email at: akureyrilodge@akureyrilodge.is

### What if our plans change?
With the standard rate you can cancel free of charge up to 14 days before arrival. If you cancel or change your booking less than 14 days before arrival, the full amount is charged to your credit card. Cancellation requests must be in writing. The non-refundable rate may be charged at any time after the booking is confirmed. It is not refunded if you cancel, change the booking or do not arrive, even if you leave early. The terms that apply to your dates are shown on the booking page before you book.

### Where is Akureyri Lodge?
At Lækjargata 3, 600 Akureyri, in Innbærinn, Akureyri’s oldest neighbourhood. Private parking is directly in front of the house.

### How old is the house?
The house was built in 1896. It was bought in 2001 and rebuilt on new foundations in 2002, keeping its original structure, and the restoration won the award of Akureyri’s house preservation fund in 2003. In 2012 the town’s building survey gave it the highest preservation value.

### What is within walking distance?
The old town is all around the house: Nonnahús and the Akureyri Museum are nine and ten minutes away on foot. The botanical garden is nine minutes, the church steps fourteen, the swimming pool sixteen, the town square eighteen and Hof twenty-one.

### How far is the airport?
Akureyri Airport is 2.5 km away, about five minutes by car.

### Do we need a car?
Not in town. The botanical garden is nine minutes on foot, the swimming pool sixteen and the town square eighteen. For Goðafoss, Mývatn or Húsavík you will want one, or a tour with pickup in Akureyri.

### How far are Goðafoss, Lake Mývatn and Húsavík by car?
Measured in Google Maps from the house: Goðafoss is about 30 minutes away, Húsavík about 1 hour, Lake Mývatn about 1 hour 6 minutes and Dettifoss about 1 hour 45 minutes by the fastest road, or about 2 hours by the paved road on the west side. The drives east go through the Vaðlaheiði tunnel, which has a toll.

### Is there a geothermal bath near the house?
Forest Lagoon is 2.6 km away, about four minutes by car, in the woods across the fjord. Akureyri’s swimming pool, Sundlaug Akureyrar, is sixteen minutes away on foot.

### Can we go whale watching from Akureyri?
Yes. Elding sails all year from the Oddeyrarbót pier in Akureyri, 23 minutes from the house on foot. Boats also leave from Dalvík, all year, and from Húsavík, from 1 March to 30 November. All three are on our tours page and are booked through TourDesk.

### Where can we eat and drink nearby?
Akureyri’s centre is just over one kilometre away on foot, and most of the restaurants, cafés and bars on our list are 14 to 20 minutes’ walk from the house. The nearest are the café in the botanical garden, ten minutes on foot, and North Restaurant, eleven minutes. Our favourite places, by occasion and with the walk to each one, are on the Food & drink page.

### Can we book tours?
Yes. Whale watching, the geothermal baths and day tours with pickup in Akureyri are on our tours page. You book and pay for most of them through TourDesk. The husky tours with Snow Dogs Iceland are booked on their own website.

### What is there to do in Akureyri in winter?
You can ski at Hlíðarfjall, 11 minutes from the house by car, usually from late November to early May. You can also bathe in the snow at Forest Lagoon and the town pool, go whale watching from the pier in town all year, and watch for the northern lights on dark, clear nights. Our winter page has the details, the daylight month by month and what to know before driving.
